output.working: Sump effective capacity V = 105 m3. Two working pumps (2W) each rated at 105 m3/h give total Q_out = 2 * 105 = 210 m3/h. Inflow Q_in is not stated in the specification, so full cycle time t_cycle_min = (V / Q_in + V / (Q_out - Q_in)) * 60 cannot be computed (status: held). The computable zero-inflow pump-out time with both working pumps running is (V / Q_out) * 60 = (105 / 210) * 60 = 30 min (compared against a minimum cycle time limit of 60 / 6 = 10 min).
